title: Use logical isolation for mutually trusted tenants
description: Combine namespaces, scoped RBAC, resource quotas, admission policy, and network policies for trusted tenants. A namespace alone is not a security boundary and does not isolate cluster-scoped resources or a shared kernel.

documentation.title: Use logical isolation for mutually trusted tenants

title: Use separate clusters for incompatible trust boundaries
description: Choose separate clusters or subscriptions where tenants are untrusted, compliance demands stronger isolation, or lifecycle and blast-radius requirements differ. Balance operational cost against the risk of a shared control plane and nodes.

documentation.title: Use separate clusters for incompatible trust boundaries

title: Use Azure tags in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
description: With Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), you can set Azure tags on an AKS cluster and its related resources by using Azure Resource Manager, through the Azure CLI.
